description: This file manages background synchronization tasks for the Notesnook mobile app, including setting up background fetch, handling background tasks on iOS and Android, and coordinating notifications, database sync, and cache cleanup.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Executes a callback in the background, handling iOS background task lifecycle.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes background fetch configuration if not already started and if background sync is enabled.

methods.name: task
methods.description: Handles background fetch events, performing background sync and signaling task completion.

methods.name: onBackgroundSyncStarted
methods.description: Performs database sync, notifications setup, and cache cleanup during background sync.

methods.name: onBoot
methods.description: Performs setup tasks on device boot, including database initialization and notifications.

methods.name: registerHeadlessTask
methods.description: Registers a headless task for background execution on app boot.
